title: Bill Phillips's Syncopators and other local bands
summary: The High Hatters turned into Bill Phillips's band, after which Breaux worked with nearly every local band, including Robichaux, Barbarin and Kid Howard.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
